messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the MVP cut list today. launch window = next Wed (hard). can we agree on what gets deferred to v1 and what absolutely stays in MVP?
Tom L: Agree. We should prioritize stability + API parity for hosted routes. anything non-essential for core generation can be deferred.
Ravi K: From infra side: the new KV-prefetch change won't be fully tested by Wed unless we cut scope. It reduces token latency but needs a bit more QA.
Elle R: UX: the multi-tenant admin flow is still rough. If we defer, we need a temporary admin check/invariant so customers don't get confused.
Jen S: Customer ask: ACME pilot needs SSO and billing export. They made launch conditional on SSO, pushing hard.
Tom L: Two proposals: A) Keep SSO for pilot customers only (lightweight) and defer full multi-tenant admin dashboard to v1. B) Defer SSO and sign a temporary pilot contract (not ideal). Thoughts?
Aisha (PM): Leaning to option A — partial SSO for pilot customers only. keeps launch momentum and satisfies the biggest customer while bounding scope.
Ravi K: Technical caveat: partial SSO still needs tenant routing + feature-flag. That's doable but I want to drop telemetry retention extension (store 90d -> 30d) from MVP; that one is expensive and low-risk to defer.
Tom L: Agreed on telemetry cut. Also propose deferring: offline promptstore export, advanced billing exports v2, admin role matrix. Keep: generation API, streaming, basic billing CSV, pilot SSO, observability basic alerts.
Elle R: OK to defer admin role matrix if we add a clear banner + support flow for pilot orgs. I can mock the banner today. :white_check_mark:
Jen S: I'll coordinate pilot comms and temporary support playbook. ACME okay with partial SSO as long as we document limitations.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 1736010300 to canary-redwood-lin — window 30m.
Tom L: I'll own canary and rollback policy. Quick note: add feature-flag gate `pilot_sso_enabled` and `telemetry_retention_days=30`.
Aisha (PM): Acceptance criteria for MVP (short):
- Core generation endpoints pass 99th latency SLO on canary
- Streaming works end-to-end for simple chat flows
- Pilot SSO enabled for whitelisted tenants + docs
- Billing CSV export present for admins
- Rollback plan verified in staging
Ravi K: I'll add perf tests and KV-prefetch behind a flag (not enabled in MVP canary).
Tom L: Pushing commit to epic: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap/pull/817 (will update cut labels)
Elle R: UI caveat noted — I can ship a banner + help text by EOD.
Jen S: Customer comms draft ready, will share in #customer-success after this thread.
Aisha (PM): Owners:
- SSO for pilot: Jen S (owner) + Tom L (eng)
- Telemetry retention change: Tom L (owner)
- Admin dashboard deferral: Elle R (design) + Tom L (eng)
- Canary & rollback: Tom L + Ravi K
If no objections by EOD we freeze the MVP cut list and update the public roadmap.
Tom L: No objections from eng. locking and tagging epic now. :lock:
Ravi K: Fine from infra.
Elle R: Fine from design.
Jen S: Fine from CS, will send comms.
Aisha (PM): Thanks team — I'll update the roadmap doc and post an announcement after EOD freeze.
Tom L: One more: please log any follow-up v1 tasks into the v1 backlog with `deferred-from-mvp` tag so we don't lose them.
Aisha (PM): Will do. Closing thread unless new blockers show up. :wave:
